PASS 11 REPLACED dead [paymentReceived ASC, status ASC] index. No client query used it. The intended behaviour (find paid orders ready to auto-complete) is currently done client-side: getOrders({status: ['pending','approved','in_process']}).filter(o => o.paymentReceived). Adding this composite makes a future server-side filter free.

Sort order kept on `name` so admin product list can sort alphabetically within a category if/when a server-side sort is added (today the call site sorts client-side).
